TermTranslation.definition: Describing the strength of pain based on a scale. For example, 1 to 10 where 1 means no pain or very little pain and 10 is the worst pain.

TermTranslation.term: achihtâsunh e wîhtamin tân eshpish âhkusîyin nesht wîsikamihchihuyin
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐊᒋᐦᑖᓱᓐᐦ ᐁ ᐐᐦᑕᒥᓐ ᑖᓐ ᐁ ᐃᔥᐱᔥ ᐋᐦᑯᓰᔨᓐ ᓀᔥᑦ ᐐᓯᑲᒥᐦᒋᐦᐅᔨᓐ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: telling by numbers how sick or how much in pain you are
